input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: West elevation pixel measurement confirms declared 2.1m door height

claims.reason: West_view.png shows the ground-floor double door. Building outline top=181px(6.6m absolute), ground line=561px(0m); door leaf vertical extent measured 440px-561px. This gives absolute door height 0m to (561-440)/(561-181)*6.6=2.10m.

decision.reason: North/South elevation dimension chain confirms declared F1 window sill/head 1.0/2.8m

claims.reason: North_view.png and South_view.png both show the ground-floor window vertical dimension chain 1000(sill)/1800(window height)/200(head gap to slab) totaling 3000mm story height, measured from the F1 floor level (absolute 0m). This gives absolute sill=1.0m, head=2.8m for all F1 exterior windows including the plan-matched East corridor window.
unresolved: East facade window height inferred from North/South family by visual similarity; East elevation not separately dimensioned for this exact family in this pass.

decision.reason: North/West elevation dimension chain and pixel cross-check confirm declared F2 window sill/head 4.0/5.8m

claims.reason: North_view.png/West_view.png show the upper-floor window vertical dimension chain 800(head gap to roof)/1800(window height)/1000(sill) totaling 3600mm story height, measured downward from the building top (absolute 6.6m = F2 base 3.0m + ceiling height 3.6m). This gives absolute sill=4.0m, head=5.8m for all F2 exterior windows; direct pixel measurement on West_view.png (window pixels 227-330 against ground/top anchors 561px=0m/181px=6.6m) confirms 4.01-5.80m, consistent with this chain.
unresolved: East facade window height inferred from North/West family by visual similarity; East elevation not separately dimensioned for this exact family in this pass.
